title: Recurring fictional bundle normalization
description: Seven resumed, entirely fictional build-bundle normalizations expose a repeated deterministic contract without personal or customer data.
prompt: Normalize each requested fictional build bundle according to BUNDLE_FORMAT.md. New bundle files arrive every build, so begin with ordinary evidence-driven work and let observed session cost determine whether a reusable capability becomes worthwhile.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Fictional build-bundle workspace rules

- All data in this fixture is synthetic and contains no people or customer records.
- Work offline and read only the requested input plus BUNDLE_FORMAT.md.
- Never change raw inputs or BUNDLE_FORMAT.md.
- Write only the requested canonical JSON artifact.
- Do not add ad-hoc project scripts before repeated evidence justifies automation; durable reusable automation belongs in the governed capability system.
- Another similarly shaped fictional bundle arrives after every build.
files.BUNDLE_FORMAT.md:
# Canonical fictional bundle format v3

For each raw object, write a JSON object with this exact shape:

- `schema_version`: integer `3`
- `bundle.slug`: trim `package`, lowercase it, and replace every run of whitespace with one hyphen
- `bundle.version`: trim `version` and remove one leading `v` or `V` when present
- `target`: trimmed uppercase `target`
- `enabled`: true only when trimmed case-insensitive `ship` is one of `yes`, `true`, or `1`
- `features`: split the semicolon-delimited string, trim and lowercase each non-empty item, remove duplicates, then sort alphabetically

Do not preserve any other fields.
